Features

Key Features

Four Roles, One Platform

Customer, Admin, Cook, and Delivery surfaces — each with the right access. No more disconnected delivery apps, POS systems, and reservation tools.

Three Fulfillment Modes

Delivery, Dine-In table reservations, and Takeaway — every order can be any of the three, with per-branch fulfillment settings.

Server-Side Order Totals

Prices are calculated on the server — clients can't manipulate them. The price the customer sees is the price they pay, enforced by Stripe webhook finalization.

Multilingual by Default (6 Locales)

English, Arabic, Filipino, Hindi, Urdu, and Bengali out of the box, with RTL-aware layouts and admin translation management.

Atomic Coupons & Secure Cancellations

Coupon counters use Firestore transactions to prevent double-redemptions. Guest cancellations are guarded by HMAC-signed, short-lived tokens.

3D Visuals & Polished UX

React Three Fiber + Three.js 3D hero, Framer Motion animations throughout, Leaflet maps, and a real-time notification bell with glow animations.

FAQ

What features does the admin dashboard include?
The admin dashboard includes order management with real-time updates and bulk status updates, menu CRUD with categories and availability toggles, coupon CRUD with per-user locks and atomic counters, branch management, reservation management, a visual floor-plan editor, driver account creation and order assignment, restaurant settings and feature flags, analytics, and customer list management.
Who are the different user roles?
DeshiKitchen has four roles. Customers browse the menu, order, pay, track delivery, and book tables. Admins have full operational control. Cooks run the kitchen order screen and update status. Delivery drivers retrieve assigned orders, update status, and report ETAs — strictly scoped to their own assignments.
Which fulfillment modes are supported?
Three: Delivery (driver assigned, real-time tracking), Dine-In (table reservation workflow with server-enforced buffer times and per-slot limits), and Takeaway (quick pickup, minimal friction). Each branch can configure its own supported modes.
Is the payment system secure?
Yes. Stripe handles all payments with webhook finalization so the payment state is authoritative on the server. Apple Pay, Google Pay, and cards are supported. Order totals are calculated on the server — clients never send prices, so prices can't be tampered with.
How does the social proof system work?
The system displays live order notifications ("Someone in Dallas just ordered Biryani"), browsing counts, dynamic dish/customer stats, and best-seller highlights — all designed to create trust and urgency in real time.
Which languages are supported?
Out of the box: English, Arabic, Filipino, Hindi, Urdu, and Bengali, with RTL-aware layouts for Arabic and Urdu. The admin translation management UI lets you keep localization up to date without redeploys.
